contexts.text: The Root of Jesse () = the Lord. AC 4594:end. AC 9256:5. AE 175:6. AE 205:6.
The Root of Jesse = the Lord from whom is this good (of innocence).

The Lord as to the Human is called the Root of David, from the fact that all Divine truth is from Him, as all things come forth and subsist from their root. Hence, too, it is that He is called also the Root of Jesse... Jesse is put for David, because he was his father.
